name: wolfram
description: Wolfram Language for Claude Code — evaluation, notebooks and Wolfram|Alpha through a seat-sharing MCP server, and code intelligence from Wolfram's own LSPServer

lsp.title: Wolfram Language code intelligence (uses a licence seat)
lsp.description: Runs Wolfram's LSPServer for diagnostics, completion and hover in .wl, .wls, .wlt and .m files. From the first such file a session opens, it holds one Wolfram licence seat for the rest of the session, outside the seats the evaluation tools share. On by default; turn it off to keep that seat.
